notes.title: Updated instructions on July 15, 2022
notes.content:
1. The UI has been updated.

UI of main menu, in game, map, editor has been updated.

The minimap will now rotate.

Action links will now only display for one second when an action is performed.

2. When selecting a unit, click the icon to jump to the corresponding position of the map.

3. Fixed drone movement bug.

notes.title: Updated instructions on July 9, 2022
notes.content: 1. All recaster effects have been updated.

notes.title: Updated instructions on July 8, 2022
notes.content:
1. Judge guidance is now one-to-many, with multiple judges leading at the same time, dividing unfurled beasts and shrikes equally among them.

2. The air force now supports formation. The air force and the army moved independently.

notes.title: Updated instructions on 5 July 2022
notes.content:
1. Updated new encounter mode! There are now four ways to win encounters.

(1) Complete annihilation

(2) Capture all population towers for a certain amount of time.

(3) Capture a population tower and score more than a certain value.

(4) Capture the human tower to gain points and the difference with the other side exceeds a certain value. (2 teams only)

2. Recaster explosion effects and debris have been updated.

3. Updated the federal Factory animation.

4. Modified AI build intervals for different map sizes.

5. Updated the unit logo icon.

notes.title: Updated instructions on 28 June 2022
notes.content:
1. Updated campaign levels 1-6.

2. Added some triggers.

3. Slightly optimized frames.

notes.title: Updated instructions on June 16, 2022
notes.content:
1. Updated the trigger system in the editor. Now you can make your own levels.

2. Updated the three levels tutorial.

3. Map of tutorial and other levels in the game root directory OtherMap folder, copy and paste into Map folder can be opened in the editor.

notes.title: Updated instructions on June 8, 2022
notes.content:
1. Recaster camp has been updated.

The model has been updated.

All structures now need to be built near the forge or unfolded judge.

Turbine removed.

The forge now supplies heat evenly to all buildings that are not already overloaded. That is, the more forgings, the fewer buildings that are not overloaded, the faster the overload speed.

2. Fixed a bug in the recaster building animation.

3. Fixed pathfinding bug when moving to large buildings.

4. Updated the recaster'S AI.

5. Evil Beast now has a constant projectile trajectory.

notes.title: Updated instructions on March 28, 2022

notes.title: Updated instructions on March 26, 2022
notes.content:
1. Dogfight mode has been added to combat mode on the Army panel

2. Aggressive mode in Engagement mode now determines whether to stop moving based on the minimum range

3. Increased the damage of electromagnetic damage weapons

notes.title: Updated instructions on March 17, 2022
notes.content:
1. Updated special effects for Federal B-cannon, tracking missiles, and electromagnetic Gatling.

2. Optimized the sound system and added the main volume and UI volume Settings.

3. Increased the federal axis speed, increased the rate of fire of the electromagnetic Gatling and reduced the damage.

4. The tracking missile's turning speed, axis speed and trajectory speed are reduced, and the minimum Angle difference of tracking missile's attack is increased from 45 degrees to 90 degrees.

5. Changed the g-force of some weapons, increased the G-force of bomber bombs from 5 to 20.

notes.title: Updated instructions on March 8, 2022
notes.content:
1. Added a new mode: Challenge mode

Defeat as many waves of enemies as possible, gaining additional resources and upgrading existing units at the end of each wave.

2. Added a level system that increases damage by 10% per level, ball shield cap by 10%, and effective health by 10% (by increasing armor, effective health is "Health /(1- Damage reduction)")

notes.title: Updated instructions on February 22, 2022
notes.content:
1. Updated the remaining federated materials

2. Slow down the game. Total unit movement speed reduced by approximately 30%, total weapon damage and spherical shield reduced by approximately 50%.

Reduced recast's building and monster health, and increased the DPS of recast drones.

3. Cancellation of the projection of the loafer missile

notes.title: Updated instructions on February 20, 2022
notes.content:
1. Updated all federated models (some materials are not finished yet)

2. Updated skybox

3. Fixed a bug where rector shapeshifted continuous attacks

4. Reworked the in-game UI, and added shortcut keys such as build

5. The Federation annex level has been removed and the prefab built directly

6. Federal modification prefabrication is reflected in the original accessories will be sold at half price

7. The manual was remade, and the preforms were set in the manual

8. Multiple units can now be built by pressing the Build button

9. Fixed a bug where the factory could not cancel the last building unit

notes.title: Updated instructions on January 24, 2022
notes.content:
1. Updated game data, widening the gap between different level units. Advanced unit population damage has been increased. Federation shield cooldown has been increased.

All units except drones now have death damage.

2. Health stripe width no longer changes with the camera.

3. Fixed a bug where recaster drones did not build forges.

4. The time when the deceleration effect faded from 100% to 0 was changed from fixed 20s to ABCD levels of 20s, 40s, 60s and 80s respectively.

5. Fixed the editor attachment deletion bug and optimized the locking effect of the editor attachment installation.

notes.title: Updated instructions on January 23, 2022
notes.content:
1. Added a crush mechanism that deals damage to low-level enemy units. Damage is proportional to rank difference and speed change.

2. Colliding enemy units is different from friendly units, which have a similar effect of avoidance.

3. Increased the elevation damage bonus, with a maximum height difference of 20m and a linear change from 0.8 to 1.2.

4. Fixed a bug where the blood bar was displayed on the back of the camera

5. Added ambient shading effect and modified some materials.

notes.title: Updated instructions on January 19, 2022
notes.content:
1. Added one-button following function (H)

2. Non-follower units now have higher selection priority

3. The formation is getting tighter

4. Formation and follow now consider following the additional size added

5. Follower units will no longer stay put when encountering obstacles

6. Fixed a bug where unit pathfinding would not move

7. Follower units are now aligned with the main orientation when stationary

notes.title: Updated instructions on January 16, 2022

notes.title: Updated instructions on December 24, 2021
notes.content:
1. Fog of War smoothed. Fog of War changes continuously when slowed down.

2. Changed weapon ranges to look like fog of War, multiple weapon ranges will be displayed together and stick to the ground.

3. When building a building or ares unit, the buildable area will be green on the ground.

4. Replace the stroke with the pattern below the unit.

notes.title: Updated instructions on December 11, 2021
notes.content:
1. Fixed yesterday's update that caused recaster to get stuck.

2. Reduced ares electromagnetic howitzer damage.

3. Fixed a bug where shells left after finishing the game.

notes.title: Updated instructions on December 10, 2021
notes.content:
1. The map editor's dimmer map will now be the first one and a mix of other maps.

2. Modified data to speed up federation build and slow down Ares build.

3. The radar system has been removed, reducing the view of some units, and improving the view of the Reforger's judge and tower, as well as the view of the two types of Ares shield recovery units. Federation radar add-ons now increase unit view to radar range.

The reason for this change is that the radar mechanic, while interesting, is mostly aimed at red dots, which makes it look bad. While radar mechanics may be familiar to the 'Supreme Commander' players, they can be confusing to those who don't play RTS often. So I decided to remove it. It was simply too hardcore and removed.

notes.title: Updated instructions on December 6, 2021
notes.content: 1. Updated the online function. After entering the room, the host can only choose the Workshop map subscribed by itself, and others will automatically subscribe and download the corresponding map after changing the map. There is a synchronization problem at present.

notes.title: Updated instructions on 5 December 2021
notes.content: 1. Workshop can now update uploaded maps

notes.title: Updated on 28 September 2021
notes.content:
1. Added online features. Creating a lobby in skirmish automatically generates a steam lobby number, sends the room number to someone else, let him copy it to his lobby number, and then join the lobby. You can also take advantage of the invitation to the lobby from the steam friends list. The online feature is joined by up to 12 people, with 8 players (that is, others watching), and only two people are tested.
2. Some models of IDF have been updated.

notes.title: Updated on August 26, 2021
notes.content:
1. Added Unforger UI theme, which can be changed in settings.
2. Removed the tutorial option in the campaign.
3. Removed the Manual.
4. Tutorial is added to the main menu, a description document with graph and word, which contains three levels of tutorial level, so that players can start the game faster and query the content they want to see.
5. The attachment installation mode is changed to select the slot and click the build icon for installation.
6. The storage method of prefab is changed to right-click temporary prefab, right-click permanent prefab can be modified, and the previous prefab files are no longer available.
7. Fixed the bug of Unforger that the Forge under construction was no longer built by other UAVs after the death of the UAV.
8. The Unforger vehicle is now regarded as two units before and after deformation, so it can have different data, such as health armor (but the current value is the same, so it can't be seen). At the same time, it will also be divided into two units in the unit list.
9. After the camera is far away, the unit logo will appear now to avoid losing sight of the unit.
10. The Unforger non Forge building can now be installed in any direction without rotation.

In addition, I built a QQ group to feed back bugs, group number 878479007. Computers with different configurations may encounter different bugs. I can't modify the bugs I can't reproduce. You can add group feedback bugs, but I can't guarantee that I can solve the bugs I can't meet.
